primary_symptoms: runny nose, sneezing, sore throat, cough
red_flag_indicators: High fever over 103F, shortness of breath, symptoms lasting > 10 days
follow_up_questions: What is your measured temperature?|Is your cough dry or with phlegm?|Are your symptoms improving or getting worse?

primary_symptoms: high fever, body aches, chills, fatigue
secondary_symptoms: dry cough, headache, sore throat, nasal congestion
red_flag_indicators: Severe shortness of breath, chest pain, persistent high fever unresponsive to antipyretics, dizziness
follow_up_questions: What was your highest recorded body temperature?|Did the symptoms start suddenly or gradually?|Are you experiencing shortness of breath?

primary_symptoms: persistent cough, chest discomfort, mucus production
possible_causes: Viral infection following cold or flu
red_flag_indicators: Coughing up blood, high fever > 101F, severe shortness of breath
follow_up_questions: Is the cough producing green or yellow mucus?|Do you have a history of asthma or COPD?|Are you having chest pain when inhaling?

primary_symptoms: severe sore throat, painful swallowing, fever
secondary_symptoms: swollen lymph nodes, red swollen tonsils with white patches, headache
red_flag_indicators: Difficulty swallowing liquids or saliva, breathing difficulty, inability to open mouth fully
follow_up_questions: Can you swallow liquids comfortably?|Do you see white spots or patches on your tonsils?|Do you also have a cough or runny nose?

primary_symptoms: fever, dry cough, fatigue, loss of taste or smell
secondary_symptoms: shortness of breath, sore throat, body aches, congestion
red_flag_indicators: Inability to catch breath, persistent chest pressure, new confusion, blue lips/fingers, SpO2 < 94%
follow_up_questions: Have you checked your oxygen saturation (SpO2)?|Have you noticed any change or loss in taste or smell?|Have you had recent close contact with a known COVID-19 case?

primary_symptoms: high fever, productive cough with colored sputum, shortness of breath
secondary_symptoms: sharp chest pain when breathing, shaking chills, fatigue, rapid heartbeat
red_flag_indicators: Severe dyspnea, bluish discoloration around mouth, confusion, resting heart rate > 100 bpm
follow_up_questions: Are you having sharp pain in your chest when breathing deeply?|What color is the phlegm you are coughing up?|Do you feel out of breath while sitting still?

primary_symptoms: sneezing, itchy watery eyes, clear runny nose
red_flag_indicators: Facial swelling, wheezing, anaphylactic signs (hives, throat tightness)
follow_up_questions: Are your eyes or throat itchy?|Do the symptoms worsen outdoors or around pets?|Do antihistamines relieve your symptoms?

primary_symptoms: throbbing unilateral headache, nausea, photophobia, phonophobia
secondary_symptoms: visual aura, vomiting, lightheadedness, neck stiffness
red_flag_indicators: Sudden 'thunderclap' headache, fever with stiff neck, weakness or numbness on one side of body
follow_up_questions: Is the pain pulsing or throbbing on one side?|Are you experiencing visual flashes or blind spots?|Is this headache similar to ones you have had in the past?

primary_symptoms: wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, coughing
possible_causes: Allergens, respiratory infection, cold air, exercise
red_flag_indicators: Struggling to speak in full sentences, retractions of neck/chest muscles, lips turning pale/blue
follow_up_questions: Do you have an existing diagnosis of asthma?|Have you used a rescue inhaler, and did it provide relief?|Are you having trouble speaking full sentences?

primary_symptoms: watery diarrhea, abdominal cramping, nausea, vomiting
red_flag_indicators: Signs of severe dehydration (no urination > 8h, extreme thirst, dizziness), blood in stool, high fever
follow_up_questions: Are you able to keep fluids down without vomiting?|Have you noticed any blood or dark black color in your stools?|How many times have you had loose bowel movements today?

primary_symptoms: severe chest pressure, radiating pain to arm or jaw, shortness of breath
possible_causes: Coronary artery disease, acute ischemia, malignant hypertension
red_flag_indicators: Crushing chest pain, pain radiating to left arm/jaw, diaphoresis, impending doom, loss of consciousness
follow_up_questions: Does the pain feel like heavy pressure or squeezing?|Does the pain spread to your left arm, jaw, or back?|Do you have a history of heart conditions or high blood pressure?

primary_symptoms: facial pain or pressure, nasal congestion, thick nasal discharge
red_flag_indicators: Swelling or redness around eyes, severe forehead headache, visual changes, high fever
follow_up_questions: Do you feel pressure when bending your head forward?|What is the color and consistency of your nasal discharge?|Has the condition lasted longer than 10 days without improvement?
